# Peeref

> > Peeref is an open science platform connecting researchers, publishers, and editors to simplify academic exchange, peer review, and research dissemination.

Peeref provides a comprehensive ecosystem for researchers including access to 60M+ papers, 38,000+ journals, funding databases, scientific protocols, and community-driven content. The platform emphasizes diamond open access publishing, peer review training, and direct collaboration between scientists.

## Core Research Discovery & Publishing

- [Browse and Publish Research Papers](https://www.peeref.com/works): Explore 60M+ research papers with AI summaries, peer reviews, and direct author access
- [Browse and Publish Scientific Posters](https://www.peeref.com/posters): Publish scientific posters with citable DOI on Peeref's open science platform
- [Browse and Publish Conference Abstracts](https://www.peeref.com/abstracts): Diamond open access publishing for conference abstracts with DOI on Peeref
- [Explore Scientific Protocols](https://www.peeref.com/protocols): Open access repository of scientific protocols with Q&A from research community

## Journal Selection & Funding Resources

- [Discover the Best Journals for Your Manuscript](https://www.peeref.com/journals): Search 38,000+ international journals by field, metrics, and submission criteria
- [Search Research Grants and Funding](https://www.peeref.com/funding): Extensive research funding database searchable by country, funder, and topic

## Peer Review & Professional Development

- [Master Peer Review Training Program](https://www.peeref.com/reviewer): Free peer reviewer training and certification program with career advancement
- [Expert Guides on Academic Careers & Publishing](https://www.peeref.com/e-collections): Expert guides on academic careers, peer review, publishing, and research development

## Educational Webinars & Learning Resources

- [Explore Free Research Webinars](https://www.peeref.com/webinars): Free expert-led research webinars from top institutions like NASA and Stanford

## Community Events & Competitions

- [Browse Research Community Activities and Trends](https://www.peeref.com/note-events): User-driven research community events, trends, and scholarly discussions
- [The Peeref International Poster Challenger: Summer 2024](https://www.peeref.com/poster-competition): Summer 2024 poster competition with people's choice voting and research awards
- [The Art of Science: Peeref 2024](https://www.peeref.com/artwork-competition): 2024 artwork competition showcasing scientific visualization and creative research
- [The 5-min Research Presentation Challenge 2024](https://www.peeref.com/webinar-competition): 2024 research presentation competition for 5-minute pitch videos with prizes
- [Reviewer Roulette Community Event](https://www.peeref.com/note-events/reviewerroulette): Community event featuring peer review experiences and research publication stories
- [Name Your Research Community Event](https://www.peeref.com/note-events/nameyourresearch): Community event for creative research title naming and science outreach engagement

## International & Multilingual Access

- [Peeref Chinese Language Platform](https://www.peeref.com/zh): Chinese language homepage for Peeref academic platform and networking

## Optional Tools & Resources

- [Free Lab Solution Calculator](https://www.peeref.com/toolbox/lab-solution-calculator): Free online calculator for dilution, reconstitution, and molarity computations
